Inspect warnings and their call stacks

Source: R/suppress_warnings.R
inspect_warnings.Rd

Runs an expression and prints diagnostic information for each warning: the warning message, condition call, and R-visible call stack. Warnings are not suppressed.

inspect_warnings(expr, stack = c("condition", "full"))

Arguments

expr

Expression to evaluate.

stack

Character scalar. "condition" prints the stack only up to the warning's conditionCall(). "full" prints the full R-visible stack, including handler internals.

Value

The value of expr, invisibly if expr returns invisibly. Called for its warning diagnostics side effect.

Examples

f <- function() {
  warning("f warned")
}

inspect_warnings(f(), stack = "condition")
